title: Baa Juice Lemon Lime 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Lemon Lime Nic Salt delivers a sharp citrus mix that’s bright and uplifting. Tangy Lemon provides a crisp bite, while juicy Lime adds a smooth, zesty finish, creating a lively vape that’s both clean and refreshing. Part of the Baa Juice Bar Salts collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid uses double-concentrated flavour to recreate the punchy taste associated with bar-style vapes. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s designed for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) vaping, ensuring balanced flavour, discreet vapour, and a smooth throat hit. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Baa Juice Lemon Lime Nic Salt is a citrus favourite made for refillable pod vape kits and starter vape kits .
